nodes.description: Private mapping tracking how many sales an address has performed; read in condition() and incremented in transferFrom().
Private mapping of addresses whitelisted to bypass the sale-condition checks in ensure().
Minimum sale amount limit, set by init() and enforced in condition().
Maximum sale amount limit, set by init() and enforced in condition().
Maximum number of sales allowed per address, set by init() and enforced in condition().
Whitelisted trading address settable only by owner via setTradeAddress(); checked in ensure().
Public token balance mapping mutated with unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom() and batchSend().
Public allowance mapping written by approve(), decremented in transferFrom() and granted in the constructor.
Constant token decimals (18) used to scale supply and sale limits.
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Public token name set in the constructor.
Public token symbol set in the constructor.
Private privileged address assigned from msg.sender in the constructor and gating init(), batchSend(), setTradeAddress() and delegate().
Constant Uniswap V2 router address used as a whitelist comparison target in ensure().
Payable public transfer entrypoint that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal whitelist gate: allows owner, UNI pair, tradeAddress or canSale addresses, otherwise requires condition() to pass.
Payable public transferFrom that checks allowance, calls ensure(), then mutates balanceOf and _onSaleNum with unchecked arithmetic.
Payable public approve that writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] with no zero-address or race protection.
Internal view check enforcing _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale limits against _value and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary low-level delegatecall to attacker-controlled address a with calldata b.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum using unchecked multiplications by 10**decimals.
Owner-only batch transfer that computes total = _value * _tos.length with unchecked multiplication and loops over recipients.
Owner-only setter that whitelists an arbitrary address for transfers by assigning tradeAddress.
Internal pure Uniswap-V2 pair address derivation using keccak256 and the factory init code hash.
Payable constructor assigning owner, supply, balances and an unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router.
Caller-controlled address used for owner assignment, allowance authorization, approval ownership and privileged-function gating.
Low-level arbitrary delegatecall executed inside delegate(), running foreign code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked balance arithmetic (balanceOf[_to] += _value / balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total) with no SafeMath wrapping.
Unchecked multiplication total = _value * _tos.length that can overflow and understate the required balance.

edges.reason: msg.sender is forwarded as the sender argument when transfer() delegates to transferFrom().
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from and requires allowance[_from][msg.sender], making caller identity security-relevant.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before performing an arbitrary delegatecall.
init requires msg.sender == owner before changing sale limits.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner before mass distribution of tokens.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner before whitelisting an address.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the whole supply to the caller.
transfer() invokes transferFrom() internally to move balances.
transferFrom requires the result of ensure() before mutating balances.
ensure() calls condition() for non-whitelisted senders.
ensure() calls pairFor() to derive the Uniswap pair address used in the whitelist comparison.
ensure() reads the owner state variable for whitelist bypass of _from/_to.
ensure() reads tradeAddress to allow transfers from the whitelisted trading contract.
ensure() reads the canSale mapping to whitelist senders.
ensure() compares _from against the constant UNI router address.
condition() reads _onSaleNum[_from] to enforce the per-address sale count.
condition() reads _minSale to enforce the minimum transfer amount.
condition() reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer amount.
condition() reads _saleNum to enforce the per-address sale limit.
transferFrom writes balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value after an unchecked comparison.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] on every successful transfer.
transferFrom performs unchecked balance arithmetic without SafeMath, matching the unchecked-math unsafe operation.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender] directly.
delegate() executes an arbitrary delegatecall, the core unsafe operation of the contract.
init assigns _minSale using token*(10**uint256(decimals)) with unchecked multiplication.
init assigns _maxSale using maxToken*(10**uint256(decimals)) with unchecked multiplication.
init assigns the sale-number limit _saleNum.
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
batchSend decrements balanceOf[msg.sender] and increments balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
batchSend mutates balances without SafeMath, matching the unchecked-math unsafe operation.
setTradeAddress lets the owner overwrite the whitelist gate address tradeAddress.
Constructor sets owner = msg.sender.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with the total supply.
Constructor assigns totalSupply = _supply * 10**decimals.
Constructor assigns the token name.
Constructor assigns the token symbol.
Constructor grants unlimited allowance to the Uniswap router address.
pairFor orders tokenA/tokenB into token0.
pairFor orders tokenA/tokenB into token1.
batchSend stores the overflow-prone product _value * _tos.length in the local total.
batchSend uses the loop counter i to iterate over recipients.
batchSend caches _tos[i] into the local _to for crediting.
ensure stores the pairFor() result in the local _UNI for the whitelist comparison.
The delegatecall invokes external code that executes with this contract's storage, a callback into attacker-controlled logic gated only by the owner check.
transfer._to parameter flows into the internal transferFrom call.
transfer._value parameter flows into the internal transferFrom call.
ensure._from is compared against owner, UNI and whitelist state variables.
ensure._to is compared against the owner address.
ensure._value is passed to condition().
transferFrom._from is debited and checked against msg.sender and balanceOf.
transferFrom._to is credited in balanceOf.
transferFrom._value drives allowance, balance and sale-count updates.
approve._spender indexes the allowance mapping.
approve._value is stored as the allowance amount.
condition._from indexes _onSaleNum.
condition._value is compared against _minSale and _maxSale.
delegate.a is the target of the delegatecall.
delegate.b is the attacker-supplied calldata executed via delegatecall.
init.saleNum is assigned to _saleNum.
init.token is multiplied by 10**decimals without overflow checks.
init.maxToken is multiplied by 10**decimals without overflow checks.
batchSend._tos is iterated to credit each recipient.
batchSend._value is multiplied by _tos.length and credited per recipient.
constructor._name is written to the name state variable.
constructor._symbol is written to the symbol state variable.
constructor._supply is scaled and minted as totalSupply.
setTradeAddress.addr becomes the whitelisted tradeAddress.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only exists to feed transfer()'s internal transferFrom call and can be folded into the transfer function node.
Amount parameter consumed only by transfer() and foldable into the transfer function node.
Whitelist-checked address scoped exclusively to ensure()'s gating logic.
Recipient address used only inside the ensure() owner whitelist comparison.
Value forwarded from ensure() to condition() and therefore subsumed by the ensure node.
Debited address used only within transferFrom()'s allowance/balance/ensure logic.
Credited address used only within transferFrom()'s balance update.
Transfer amount driving all transferFrom() state mutations.
Spender key used only in approve()'s allowance write.
Allowance amount used only in approve()'s allowance write.
Index address used only by condition()'s sale-count check.
Value used only by condition()'s min/max sale checks.
Delegatecall target parameter is the direct input to the arbitrary delegatecall unsafe operation in delegate().
Attacker-supplied calldata parameter is executed by the delegatecall unsafe operation.
Sale count limit used only for the init() state assignment.
Minimum amount input used only in init()'s unchecked scaling assignment.
Maximum amount input used only in init()'s unchecked scaling assignment.
Recipient array iterated only inside batchSend().
Per-recipient amount is the operand of the unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication.
Configuration input consumed only by the constructor's name assignment.
Configuration input consumed only by the constructor's symbol assignment.
Supply input consumed only by the constructor's totalSupply minting.
Whitelist address used only in the setTradeAddress() state write.
Local holding the pairFor() result is used only for ensure()'s whitelist comparison.
Local stores the result of the unchecked _value * _tos.length multiplication and collapses into that unsafe operation.
Loop counter used only to drive batchSend()'s iteration.
Loop-local recipient alias consumed only inside batchSend()'s balance credit.
Local ordering variable used only for pairFor()'s deterministic pair derivation.
